title: Sorry to the haters, Audra McDonald is breathtaking in Gypsy #Broadwa...
transcript: Y'all are not ready for what Audra McDonald is doing in this show. And trust me, I was one of the people that was skeptical when this casting was announced. I think Audra is insanely talented, but I was one of the people saying, I just don't know that this role is a good fit for her voice type, but wow, was I wrong. Because yes, she is different vocally from all of the Mama roses that have came before her, but I actually thought her tone and that more classic, legit style actually works really, really well for both the score and the character. Because nowadays that more classic style of singing has kind of gone out of style in favor of belting. And since Mama Rose is a character that opines about being born in the wrong era, I kind of like that stylistically, she is singing from a different era as the people around her. I also thought that Audra had a way of delivering some of these lines that felt like I was hearing them for the very first time, even though I've seen Gypsy like a million times. the fact that she is able to so effortlessly reinvent this character that has been reinvented so many times, I think really speaks to just how talented Audra McDonald is. And I know that's a weird thing to say about the most Tony awarded actress of all time. Like, it should come as no shock that She's really good at what she does. And yet I continue to be so blown away by her. Every single time I see her, her roses turn completely altered my brain chemistry. And dare I say, might be definitive. I already have taken to go back multiple times, and I absolutely cannot wait.
classificationReason: Creator shares a detailed first-hand opinion of Audra McDonald's performance in Gypsy — discussing vocal style, character interpretation, and line delivery. Clear review of the 2024 stage production.
